note: Frozen for contract 1.0.0. Phase 4 ships DUPLICATE_PAYMENT and PARTIAL_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION; the catalog declares all four types with status so later phases extend without contract drift.

types.affected_id_rule: The new payment id created by the operator plus the journal-entry id that records exactly that payment. Original payment and invoice stay evidence-only.
evidence_requirements: target invoice row with currency, total_minor and due date
original allocation of the same invoice by the original payment
duplicate payment row with its allocation to the same invoice
absence of credit note / refund / void that would explain the overpayment
types.amount_definition: Sum of allocations to the invoice above total_minor minus valid credit notes, expressed in invoice currency minor units.

types.affected_id_rule: The payment id carrying the wrong allocation plus the invoice id whose remaining balance is directly affected.
types.amount_definition: Difference between the allocated amount and the amount the policy allocation rule requires, in invoice currency minor units.
evidence_requirements: payment row with amount_minor and its allocations
target invoice total, prior allocations and credit notes
absence of a second payment that legitimately closes the remainder

types.affected_id_rule: Journal entries whose booked rate differs from the policy-required rate.
types.amount_definition: Functional-currency difference between booked and policy-required functional amount.

types.affected_id_rule: Journal entries whose posting_period disagrees with the policy recognition period.
types.amount_definition: Functional amount recognised in the wrong period.
